description: This file defines the LogFragment class, a fragment that contains a log view (LogView) for displaying log data within an Android application. It manages UI setup including a ScrollView and configures text appearance and behavior for the log display.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that creates a view containing a LogView inside a ScrollView, used for displaying logs.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Constructs and returns the main view hierarchy including ScrollView and LogView, with configured layout parameters and styling.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's view by inflating the UI layout, attaching a TextWatcher to the LogView to auto-scroll when text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
